verification.evidence_note: The successful push-event full-suite run is the exact-head verification. The pull-request CI event is skipped by workflow condition.

implemented_this_run: Integrated paired uncertainty diagnostics into chronological walk-forward output
Added deterministic tests for paired temporal and source-clustered resampling
Added a walk-forward integration test that refuses source-clustered confidence intervals when only one canonical source group exists

method.comparison: Paired Brier and log-loss differences for each deterministic baseline versus naive_class_prior
method.temporal_bootstrap: Circular moving blocks, default block length 5 origins, 1000 resamples, minimum 30 paired origins
method.source_clustered_bootstrap: Resample canonical source-independence groups, then temporal blocks within each group; minimum 5 source groups and 2 origins per group
method.interpretation: Negative loss difference favors the compared model; source groups are provenance labels, not proof of statistical independence

prediction_engine.current_scope: Deterministic baselines only: naive, momentum, mean reversion and volatility
prediction_engine.admission_gate_integration: Bootstrap diagnostics are reported by walk-forward but are not yet required by the independent forecast-readiness ledger
prediction_engine.source_cluster_status: A single-venue evaluation typically has one canonical source group and correctly returns INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE_CLUSTERS
remaining_gaps: Synchronized historical spot, L2, derivatives, exchange-flow and collateral dataset
Independent WORM archive and trusted timestamp anchoring
Candidate-versus-each-baseline paired uncertainty in the readiness ledger

spot.cross_venue_conclusion: Quotes are asynchronous and do not establish an executable arbitrage opportunity or a fresh consolidated spot price.

orderbook.limitation: Approximately four hours old; resting orders can be cancelled; not executable spot depth

derivatives.limitation: Liquidation clusters are modelled from open interest and leverage tiers, not actual resting liquidation orders.

market.derivatives_disagreement: Open-interest totals differ materially by venue universe and timestamp. Do not average. Long liquidation skew appears in multiple vendor snapshots, but coverage overlaps and no directional forecast follows.

etf_flows.funds: Six US spot XRP ETFs plus BITW; GXRP is excluded from flow totals during a data-gap correction
etf_flows.methodology: Holdings deltas, not issuer cash creation/redemption reports; BITW index rebalancing and fee accruals can appear as flow.
etf_flows.disagreement: CryptoKeyhole has incomplete November 12 issuer files; Alpha Finance's five-fund cohort reports zero for November 12. Different universes and missing-file treatment; do not average.

exchange_wallet_balances.limitation: Includes cold storage, omnibus and wrapped-asset backing; same-wallet deltas cannot distinguish customer withdrawals from internal wallet rotations or newly untracked addresses.
